title: The Physical Computing Loop
description: Input, process, output -- stepped one stage at a time, with the actual data each stage is holding.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Physical Computing and Electrical Safety Basics

educational.audience: Mentors and students starting physical computing

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a physical computing project description, the learner explains which part of the input-process-output loop each component belongs to.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Pick a project, then click a stage or step through it and read the data that stage is handling
pedagogical.assessment: Name a component from a student's project and ask which stage it belongs to.
